title: Rochdale Winter Ale Trail returns to nine town centre pubs from 12 to 15 November
excerpt: The Rochd'ale' Winter Ale Trail runs from Thursday 12 to Sunday 15 November across nine Rochdale town centre pubs and bars, with a free T-shirt for anyone who collects all nine stamps.
legal_disclaimer: This article was compiled from identified public sources and may be updated when further verified information becomes available.
right_to_reply: Anyone directly affected may request a correction or right of reply by emailing news@rochdaledaily.co.uk.

corrections.note: Corrected on 12 November 2026: an earlier version gave the dates as 12 to 13 November. The trail runs from Thursday 12 to Sunday 15 November.

body:
The Rochd'ale' Winter Ale Trail returns to Rochdale town centre from Thursday 12 November to Sunday 15 November.

Organised by Rochdale Town Centre BID, the trail takes in nine pubs and bars: The Flying Horse Hotel, The Regal Moon, Hogarths, Our Gracie's, The Baum, Empire, The Pint Pot, The Lucky Duck and Moody Blue.

Visitors can pick up an Ale Trail stamp card from any of the venues and collect a stamp at each one. Anyone who collects all nine stamps can claim a free limited-edition Ale Trail T-shirt.

People who share photos of their ale trail drinks and stamps on social media can also enter a draw to win a real ale hamper.

Rochdale Town Centre BID said: “The trail is a fun, sociable way to discover Rochdale's pubs, support local businesses and enjoy the town centre's hospitality over four days.”
